messages:
Evan: Hey everyone, Evan here (first week). Quick access help: need read + SA impersonation on GCP project `ci-playground-9` so our GitHub Actions can run integration tests in ap-southeast-1, plus permission to assume AWS role `arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/RedwoodGithubRunner`. I opened the project console and the Cloud Console shows 403 on IAM and Compute pages. Who can help with the minimal set of perms?

Sofia: Welcome Evan! For GCP, list the project ID (looks like `ci-playground-9`) and the service account email you want to impersonate. We usually grant `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` on the SA and `roles/viewer` on the project for read-only. For AWS we typically add new hires to `github-runners-crossacct` group. Do you have your SSO principal?

Evan: SSO is redwood/evan, email evan@redwood.com. SA is `gha-runner-sa@ci-playground-9.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. The 403 message on Compute says: "You do not have permission to view VM instances (403)".

Maya: I manage the sandbox folders. Quick heads up: `ci-playground-9` is under folder `internal-sandbox` which currently has `constraints/restrictResourceLocations` set to `[europe-west1, us-central1]`. That will block APAC region creation. We can do two things: temporary project exception for the single region, or create a separate project under `apac-sandbox`. Which is preferable?

Evan: I prefer the temp exception so the CI job can run in ap-southeast-1 for the partner build tomorrow. Might be quicker.

Sofia: Great. Can you run these checks and paste outputs (redact tokens):

```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy ci-playground-9 --format=json

gcloud alpha resource-manager org-policies list --project=ci-playground-9 --format=json

aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/RedwoodGithubRunner --role-session-name evan-onboard-test || true
```

Evan: Pasted (redacted): project IAM bindings only list `group:sandbox-admins@redwood.com` and `serviceAccount:ci-runner@ci-playground-9.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Org policies show `constraints/restrictResourceLocations: [europe-west1, us-central1]`. AWS assume-role returned `AccessDenied` as expected.

Maya: Thanks. I'll open a short-lived exception to add `ap-southeast-1` to the project's allowed resource locations for 36 hours and add evan@redwood.com to `sandbox-iam-viewers` so you can at least inspect bindings. After that we still need to grant `iam.serviceAccountUser` on the SA and add you to the cross-account AWS group.

grant-bot: Ticket CLOUD-8606 created: "Onboard Evan: APAC exception + SA impersonation + AWS crossacct group add". Assigned to infra; priority P2. ETA: 8 business hours. :robot_face:

Sofia: For the GitHub Actions impersonation make sure the runner uses `gcloud auth print-identity-token --impersonate-service-account=gha-runner-sa@ci-playground-9.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and that the SA has the right IAM roles for the jobs it runs. If you need to test locally, `gcloud auth login --brief` then `gcloud auth print-access-token --impersonate-service-account=...` works.

Evan: Appreciate it. Two quick questions: 1) who approves billing for temporary region exceptions (if CI spins up VMs)? 2) what's the typical cost cap for onboarding runs?

finance-bot: For short onboarding exceptions we preapprove up to $15 per session; anything above requires a finance ticket. We'll log usage to the billing project and notify if it approaches the cap. I've linked CLOUD-8606 to FIN-9120 for tracking. :money_with_wings:

Maya: I've granted `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` on `gha-runner-sa@ci-playground-9.iam.gserviceaccount.com` to evan@redwood.com and added `ap-southeast-1` as an allowed location for 36 hours. Also added evan@redwood.com to `sandbox-iam-viewers`. You should be able to impersonate the SA and create one small test VM now.

Evan: I can now run `gcloud compute instances create test-small --zone=ap-southeast-1-b --image-family=debian-11 --image-project=debian-cloud` and it started provisioning. CI ran and the job completed. Latency to partner endpoint ~120ms. Thanks all! :tada:

Sofia: I'll follow up to add you to `github-runners-crossacct` so your AWS assume-role works; expect that in the next 2 business days. If AWS assume-role still fails after group add, post the `aws sts assume-role` CLI output here and we'll troubleshoot.

Evan: Will do. One more note: saw a quota error when provisioning more than one VM in parallel (`Quota 'CPUS' exceeded`). Anyone who can temporarily bump the CPU quota for ap-southeast-1?

Maya: Quota bumps need a support request; I can request a temporary bump in the project for the session. I'll add that to CLOUD-8606.

grant-bot: CLOUD-8606 updated: requested CPU quota bump of +8 in ap-southeast-1 for project `ci-playground-9`. Support ticket created with cloud provider.

Evan: Perfect. Thanks again everyone — saved me a lot of time getting CI green on day one.
